mapper.sql: business_id, analysis_id, task_id, message_id, dispatch_id, tenant_id, project_id, request_type, question, agent_question_id, allowed_roles, input_schema, status, decision, response_json, response_idempotency_key, expires_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO human_request (business_id, analysis_id, tenant_id, project_id, request_type, question, allowed_roles, input_schema, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{analysisId}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, 'CLARIFICATION', #{question}, 'OWNER,MEMBER', #{inputSchema}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO human_request (business_id, task_id, tenant_id, project_id, request_type, question, agent_question_id, allowed_roles, input_schema, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, 'CLARIFICATION', #{question}, #{agentQuestionId}, 'OWNER,MEMBER', #{inputSchema}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = 'WAITING_HUMAN', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT plan_id FROM coordinator_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_plan SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{planId}

UPDATE coordinator_dispatch SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = (SELECT message_id FROM coordinator_plan WHERE business_id = #{planId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM human_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT FROM human_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE human_request SET status = 'RESOLVED', decision = #{decision}, response_json = #{responseJson}, response_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, responded_by = #{userId}, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE human_request SET message_id = #{messageId}, dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} WHERE business_id = #{id}
